assets.title: Opportunity explorer
assets.use: Discovery, opportunity search, or an opening video character.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated full-body flat cartoon character on transparent background, square composition. A curious young adult with warm tan skin and one bold shape of short curly navy hair holds a small pair of navy binoculars to their eyes with both hands and looks diagonally up to the right. A cream cross-body messenger bag hangs at their left hip. They wear a cobalt oversized sweatshirt, wide terracotta trousers and chunky cream sneakers with navy soles. Stand in an energetic but balanced wide stance with bent knees, body turned three-quarter right. A charming visual metaphor for finding an opportunity. Keep the silhouette simple with clear separation between arms and torso. Only character, binoculars and bag. STYLE IS THE MAIN REQUIREMENT: extremely simple flat 2D cartoon, bold vector-like paper-cut shapes, clean solid uniform fills, no outlines around silhouettes, no texture or grain, no shading, no gradients, no lighting, no highlights, no crosshatching, no volume, no realistic anatomy or facial rendering. Friendly stylized adult characters built from a few rounded geometric shapes: slightly oversized heads, small dot eyes, tiny geometric noses, one simple curved smile, mitten-like simplified hands, thick rounded limbs and oversized flat shoes. Sophisticated minimal illustration for a friendly career website, playful and immediately readable at thumbnail size. Clothing has only one or two internal detail lines, hair is one flat silhouette, faces have at most five simple marks. Limit entire image to cobalt #2563EB, deep navy #0A1738, light periwinkle #DCE8FC, warm cream #FAF9F6, terracotta #E78955 plus two appropriate natural skin-tone flat colors. Cobalt is the main accent. Genuine transparent background; no colored rectangle, blob, floor, cast shadow, halo or surrounding scenery. All subjects entirely visible, generous 10 percent clear margin. No text, no letters, no symbols pretending to be text, no logos, no watermark, no photorealism, no 3D, no anime, no detailed hair strands. This is a PNG illustration asset, not a poster or webpage.
